description.text: Objectives This project will be carried out through the course study and subject research to get a better understanding of the further adjustment of the academic directions and the cross and the intergration between diciplines. Meanwhile, it will use the information technology, new material technology, the energy saving and environmental protection technology to improve the traditional mechanical engineering disciplines. Thus, the academic directions, scientific researches and personnel training objectives will adapt to the modern science and technology development trends. Some innovative productions will be obtained in the Electrical Transmission and its control, the Mechanical Equipment Test, the Modern Design of Machinery and the Network-based Manufacturing Systems. High-level international talents in Mechanical Engineering or related fields will be cultivated through the project. Program Features ◆Students will be familiar with the solid theoretical foundation and broad engineering knowledge of the field of mechanical engineering, emphasizing engineering practice, focusing on the application of knowledge. ◆Get hold of the advanced technical method and modern technical instrumentality in resolving engineering problems. ◆Having the ability of application, development, integrated knowledge and practice, being able to manage the field of engineering and engineering management work independently , having the ability of engaging scientific research in the field of machinery ,teaching or managing the relevance technical job on one's own, being able to read the foreign informationa in a field proficiently and preliminary using foreign language for international communication capabilities. Degree Award Students are required to complete the curriculum in 2.5, fulfill the designated degree courses, complete the master's thesis and defend of it in front of a panel of experts. Graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the Master’s degree.

duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering at Harbin Engineering University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be foreigners in good health. 2.Applicants must hold bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35.
